metadata.purpose: Shared recursive destination model plus responsive, host-aware and accessibility-safe navigation presentation rules.

state.activeAncestorIds: derived ancestor chain for the active destination; never a substitute for active destination
state.expandedNodeIds: independent disclosure state; may include active ancestors but remains separately mutable
rules: Selecting a destination changes activeDestinationId without implicitly toggling disclosure.
Activating a disclosure target changes expandedNodeIds without navigating the parent destination.
Active ancestors remain visually identifiable even when a user manually collapses their descendants.
Use persistent label-first Side Navigation when the product benefits from a stable navigation region.
The navigation region may scroll independently while App Shell owns content offset and resize.
Recursive children remain available without a Core depth cap.
Navigation Rail is eligible as an icon-first compact presentation when every destination retains an accessible label.
A user or product may keep expanded Side Navigation when task clarity needs labels; viewport alone does not force Rail.
Nested destinations use disclosure, flyout, drawer or an expanded navigation surface rather than becoming hover-only.
For 3–5 stable top-level destinations, Bottom Navigation is the preferred direct-destination presentation.
For deep or numerous destinations, use Drawer or Sheet multi-level collapsible navigation instead of a horizontally scrolling destination strip.
Top App Bar owns page-level navigation UI only; host/system chrome remains outside Core.

topAppBar.titleCentering: center within the available safe navigation region after leading actions, trailing actions and platform reserved regions are excluded
topAppBar.titleWidthRule: derive from available safe navigation region; never overlap leading/trailing actions or host reserved regions

touch.rule: Both destination and disclosure remain independently operable touch targets when a parent is also navigable.

keyboard.focusRestoreAfterCollapse: restore to the disclosure owner when a focused descendant becomes hidden
keyboard.semanticRolePolicy: Use navigation/list semantics for ordinary destination navigation; use tree semantics only when the interaction actually implements tree behavior.
